name: Star Trek: Elite Force II
description: Star Trek: Elite Force II is a singleplayer and multiplayer first-person shooter game and the second in the Star Trek: Elite Force series.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX 3 sound
audio_settings.reason: The game's sound driver is not set to EAX out of the box. This sets the Miles driver to EAX 3 and the sample rate to 44 kHz.

audio_settings.title: Enable Stereo speaker mode
audio_settings.reason: Sets the in-game setting to stereo sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable headphone speaker mode
audio_settings.reason: Sets the in-game settings to headphones.

audio_settings.title: Enable Pro Logic surround
audio_settings.reason: Sets the in-game settings to surround sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable 4.0 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: Sets the in-game settings to Quadrophonic.

audio_settings.title: Enable 5.1 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: Sets the in-game settings to 5.1 surround sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable 7.1 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: Sets the in-game settings to 7.1 surround sound.
